```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# 1. Read JSON file
json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/items_dashboard.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

ojs_groups <- lapply(seq_along(json_data$items), function(i) {
  group <- json_data$items[[i]]
  raw_data <- group$data
  
  df_list <- lapply(raw_data, function(row) {
    as.data.frame(t(as.character(row)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  
  df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  
  timestamps <- df[[1]]
  val_df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  value_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(val_df, function(col) as.numeric(col)))
  
  plot_labels <- if (!is.null(group$options$labels)) group$options$labels[-1] else group$titles
  checkbox_titles <- if (!is.null(group$titles)) group$titles else plot_labels
  
  # Extract axis mapping configuration from options$series
  series_opts <- list()
  if (!is.null(group$options$series)) {
    series_opts <- group$options$series
  }
  
  list(
    index = i,                      # 1-based index (1, 2, 3, ...)
    index_zero = i - 1,             # 0-based index for JavaScript (0, 1, 2, ...)
    group_id = paste0("group_", i), # String ID (e.g., "group_1")
    title = group$title,
    titles = unlist(checkbox_titles),
    labels = unlist(plot_labels),
    colors = unlist(group$options$colors),
    dsets = unlist(group$options$sets),
    names = unlist(group$options$names),
    query = unlist(group$options$query),
    mint = unlist(group$options$minT),
    maxt = unlist(group$options$maxT),
    inst = unlist(group$options$inst),
    summary = unlist(group$options$summary),
    visibility = as.logical(unlist(group$options$visibility)),
    ylabel = group$options$ylabel,
    y2label = group$options$y2label,
    series = series_opts,
    timestamps = timestamps,
    values = value_matrix,
    strokewidth = group$options$strokeWidth,
    pointsize = group$options$pointSize,
    highlightcirclesize = group$options$highlightCircleSize,
    datewindow = group$options$dateWindow,
    xrangepad = group$options$xRangePad,
    yrangepad = group$options$yRangePad,
    rightgap = group$options$rightGap
  )
})
# 3. Export all groups to OJS
ojs_define(allGroups = ojs_groups)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Load local Dygraphs library
Dygraph = require(await FileAttachment("lib/dygraph/dygraph.min.js").url())

html`${allGroups.map((group, groupIdx) => {
  
  const checkboxInputs = Inputs.checkbox(
    group.titles, 
    { 
      value: group.titles.filter((_, i) => group.visibility[i])
    }
  );
  
  const indinfo = Inputs.checkbox(
    group.titles, 
    { 
      value: group.titles.filter((_, i) => group.visibility[i])
    }
  );
  
  const legdivht = 50 + (group.titles.length*30);
  
  
  // Generate dynamic CSS rules to style each checkbox label & input by color
  const dynamicStyles = html`<style>
    ${group.colors.map((color, idx) => `
      /* Scope styles specifically to this group index */
      .group-cb-${groupIdx} label:nth-child(${idx + 1}) {
        color: ${color} !important;
        font-weight: 400;
        display: block;
      }
      .group-cb-${groupIdx} label:nth-child(${idx + 1}) input[type="checkbox"] {
        accent-color: ${color} !important;
        color: white;
      }
    `).join("")}
    #legdiv_${groupIdx} {height : ${legdivht} px;}
  </style>`;

  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.style.width = "100%";
  chartContainer.style.height = "300px";
  chartContainer.style.position = "relative";
  chartContainer.style.marginTop = "10px";
  chartContainer.style.marginBottom = "40px";

  const chartData = group.timestamps.map((t, rowIdx) => {
    const row = [new Date(t)];
    for (let colIdx = 0; colIdx < group.labels.length; colIdx++) {
      row.push(group.values[rowIdx][colIdx]);
    }
    return row;
  });

  checkboxInputs.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const selectedTitles = checkboxInputs.value;
    const currentVisibility = group.titles.map(title => selectedTitles.includes(title));
  
    if (chartContainer._dygraphInstance) {
      chartContainer._dygraphInstance.updateOptions({ visibility: currentVisibility });
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const initialVisibility = group.titles.map(title => checkboxInputs.value.includes(title));
    
    chartContainer._dygraphInstance = new Dygraph(chartContainer, chartData, {
      labels: ["Time", ...group.labels],
      colors: group.colors,
      visibility: initialVisibility,
      ylabel: group.ylabel || "",
      y2label: group.y2label || "",
      series: group.series || {},  // Assigns specified series to 'y2' axis
      legend: "always",
      hideOverlayOnMouseOut: false,
      showRangeSelector: true,
      labelsSeparateLines: true,
      labelsDiv: "legdiv_"+group.index,
      strokeWidth: group.strokewidth,
      pointSize: group.pointsize,
      highlightCircleSize: group.highlightcirclesize,
      dateWindow: group.datewindow,
      xRangePad: group.xrangepad,
      yRangePad: group.yrangepad,
      rightGap: group.rightgap
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      chartContainer._dygraphInstance.resize();
    }, 50);
  });
  
  const sectionSlug = group.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');

  return html`
    ${dynamicStyles}
    <div id="grp${groupIdx}" class="custom-container" style="padding: 15px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e9ecef; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 25px;">
      <div class="custom-sidebar group-cb-${groupIdx}">
      <span class="custom-sidebar-title">Choose indicator:</span>
      ${checkboxInputs}
      </div>
      <div class="custom-main">
      <div><h3 id="sec-${sectionSlug}">${group.title}</h3></div>
      <div id="legdiv_${group.index}"></div>
      ${chartContainer}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
})}`

```



## Indicator Information & Download


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

baseurl = "https://oceanview.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/tabledap/"

geturl <- function(dset,fmt,query,baseurl){
  url=paste0(baseurl,dset,".",fmt, sep="")
  if(exists(query) && !is.null(query))paste0(url,"?&",query,sep="")
  return(url)
}

for (group in json_data$items) {
  ningr = 0
  for (i in seq_along(group$titles)) {
    indtitle <- group$titles[[i]]
    if(group$title=="Upwelling Index"){
      if(i>3)break
      indtitle <- substr(indtitle,1,nchar(indtitle)-5)
      }
    if(group$title=="Habitat Compression"){
      if(i>1)break
      indtitle <- substr(indtitle,1,nchar(indtitle)-9)
      }
    if(group$title=="Upwelling Index - Daily")break
    ningr=ningr+1
    if(ningr == 1)cat("### ",group$title, "\n\n",sep="")
    clean_desc <- gsub("<[^>]+>", "", group$summary[[i]])
      title = indtitle
      description = trimws(clean_desc)
      institution = group$inst[[i]]
      trange = paste0(substr(group$minT[[i]],1,10)," - ",substr(group$maxT[[i]],1,10),sep="")
    csv = geturl(group$dsets[[i]],'csv',group$query[[i]],baseurl)
    html = geturl(group$dsets[[i]],'html',group$query[[i]],baseurl)
    
    cat("#### **",title,"**\n",sep="")
    cat(description,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Institution*: ",institution,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Time Range:* ", trange,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Download:*&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;  [csv file](",csv,")&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;","[Go to ERDDAP&#8482;](", html,")\n\n" ,sep="") 
   }
}
```
